087        public boolean shouldHaveCommodity(CommodityOnMarketAPI com) {
088                if (market.isIllegal(com)) {
089                        if (com.getCommodityMarketData().getMarketShareData(market).isSourceIsIllegal()) {

091                        }
092                        return true;
093                }
094                return true;
095        }

099                if (Commodities.PARTS.equals(stack.getCommodityId())) return false;

101                if (stack.getResourceIfResource().hasTag(Commodities.TAG_NON_ECONOMIC)) return true;
102                return false;
103        }

112        @Override
113        public int getStockpileLimit(CommodityOnMarketAPI com) {
114                
115                int demand = com.getMaxDemand();
116                
117//              if (market.getId().toLowerCase().contains("ed1:planet_2") && com.getId().equals(Commodities.METALS)) {
118//                      System.out.println("wflwefwefwe");
119//              }
120                
121                int shippingGlobal = com.getCommodityMarketData().getMaxShipping(com.getMarket(), false);
122                //int shippingInFaction = com.getCommodityMarketData().getMaxShipping(com.getMarket(), true);
123                
124                int available = com.getAvailable();
125                String modId = submarket.getSpecId();
126                StatMod mod = com.getAvailableStat().getFlatStatMod(modId);
127                if (mod != null) {
128                        available -= (int) mod.value;
129                        if (available < 0) available = 0;
130                }
131                
132                int production = com.getMaxSupply();
133                production = Math.min(production, available);
134                        
135                int export = 0;
136                demand = com.getMaxDemand();
137                export = (int) Math.min(production, shippingGlobal);
138                
139                int extra = available - Math.max(export, demand);
140                if (extra < 0) extra = 0;
141                
142                int deficit = demand - available;
143//              int demandMet = Math.min(available, demand);
144//              int demandMetWithLocal = Math.min(available, production) - extra;
145                int imports = available - production;
146                if (imports < 0) imports = 0; 
147                
148                production -= extra;
149                
150                float unit = com.getCommodity().getEconUnit();
151//              if (com.getId().equals("supplies") && getMarket().isPlayerOwned()) {
152//                      System.out.println("fwewfwefwefwe");
153//              }
154                float limit = 0f;
155                limit += STOCKPILE_MULT_EXCESS * BaseIndustry.getSizeMult(extra) * unit;
156                limit += STOCKPILE_MULT_PRODUCTION * BaseIndustry.getSizeMult(production) * unit;
157                limit += STOCKPILE_MULT_IMPORTS * BaseIndustry.getSizeMult(imports) * unit;
158                
159                String cid = com.getId();
160                if (stockpilingBonus.containsKey(cid)) {
161                        limit += stockpilingBonus.get(cid).getModifiedValue() * unit;
162                }
163                
164                //limit *= com.getMarket().getStockpileMult().getModifiedValue();
165                limit *= STOCKPILE_MAX_MONTHS;
166                
167//              if (Misc.isExtended()) {
168//                      limit *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_localResourcesStockpileMult");
169//              }
170                
171                if (deficit > 0 || Math.max(0f, demand) + Math.max(0f, production) <= 0) {
172                        limit = 0;
173                }
174                
175                if (limit < 0) limit = 0;
176                
177                return (int) limit;
178        }

310        public int getEstimatedShortageCounteringCostPerMonth() {
311                List<CommodityOnMarketAPI> all = new ArrayList<CommodityOnMarketAPI>(market.getAllCommodities());
312                
313                float totalCost = 0f;
314                
315                CargoAPI cargo = getCargo();
316                
317                for (CommodityOnMarketAPI com : all) {
318                        int curr = (int) cargo.getCommodityQuantity(com.getId());
319                        if (curr <= 0) continue;
320                        
321                        float units = LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin.getDeficitMonthlyCommodityUnits(com);
322                        units = Math.min(units, cargo.getCommodityQuantity(com.getId()));
323                        units -= taken.getCommodityQuantity(com.getId());
324                        if (units > 0) {
325                                float per = LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin.getStockpilingUnitPrice(com.getCommodity(), true);
326                                totalCost += units * per;
327                        }
328                }
329                return (int) totalCost;
330        }

332        public static int getStockpilingUnitPrice(CommoditySpecAPI spec, boolean forShortageCountering) {
333                float mult = STOCKPILE_COST_MULT;
334                if (forShortageCountering) mult = STOCKPILE_SHORTAGE_COST_MULT;
335                int result = (int) Math.round((spec.getBasePrice() * mult));
336                if (result < 1) result = 1;
337                return result;
338//              float unitPrice = market.getDemandPrice(com.getId(), 1, true);
339//              if (unitPrice < 1) unitPrice = 1;
340//              return (int) unitPrice;
341        }
342        
343        public static float getDeficitMonthlyCommodityUnits(CommodityOnMarketAPI com) {
344                String modId = Submarkets.LOCAL_RESOURCES;
345                
346                StatMod mod = com.getAvailableStat().getFlatMods().get(modId);
347                float modAlready = 0;
348                if (mod != null) modAlready = mod.value;
349                
350                int demand = com.getMaxDemand();
351                int available = (int) Math.round(com.getAvailable() - modAlready);
352                
353                if (demand > available) {
354                        float deficitDrawBaseAmount = BaseIndustry.getSizeMult(demand) - BaseIndustry.getSizeMult(available);
355                        deficitDrawBaseAmount *= com.getCommodity().getEconUnit();
356                        return deficitDrawBaseAmount;
357                }
358                return 0;
359        }
360        
361        protected boolean doShortageCountering(CommodityOnMarketAPI com, float amount, boolean withShortageCountering) {
362                CargoAPI cargo = getCargo();
363                String modId = submarket.getSpecId();
364                
365                com.getAvailableStat().unmodifyFlat(modId);
366                
367                int demand = com.getMaxDemand();
368                int available = com.getAvailable();
369
370//              if (com.isIllegal() && com.getMarket().isPlayerOwned()) {
371//                      System.out.println("wefwefew");
372//              }
373                
374                if (withShortageCountering && demand > available) {
375                        // draw resources and apply bonus
376                        int deficit = demand - available;
377                        if (deficit != deficit) return false; // bug report indicates possible NaN here; not sure how
378                        
379                        float deficitDrawBaseAmount = BaseIndustry.getSizeMult(demand) - BaseIndustry.getSizeMult(available);
380                        deficitDrawBaseAmount *= com.getCommodity().getEconUnit();
381                        
382                        float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
383                        
384                        float drawAmount = deficitDrawBaseAmount * days / 30f;
385                        float curr = cargo.getCommodityQuantity(com.getId());
386                        if (curr > 0 && deficitDrawBaseAmount > 0) {
387                                int daysLeft = (int) (curr / deficitDrawBaseAmount * 30f);
388                                String daysStr = "days";
389                                if (daysLeft <= 1) {
390                                        daysLeft = 1;
391                                        daysStr = "day";
392                                }
393                                com.getAvailableStat().modifyFlat(modId, deficit, 
394                                                        "Local resource stockpiles (" + daysLeft + " " + daysStr + " left)");
395                                
396                                float free = left.getCommodityQuantity(com.getId());
397                                free = Math.min(drawAmount, free);
398                                left.removeCommodity(com.getId(), free);
399                                if (drawAmount > 0) {
400                                        cargo.removeCommodity(com.getId(), drawAmount);
401                                }
402                                drawAmount -= free;
403                                
404                                if (market.isPlayerOwned() && drawAmount > 0) {
405                                        MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
406                                        FDNode node = report.getCounterShortageNode(market);
407                                        
408                                        CargoAPI tooltipCargo = (CargoAPI) node.custom2;
409                                        float addToTooltipCargo = drawAmount;
410                                        float q = tooltipCargo.getCommodityQuantity(com.getId()) + addToTooltipCargo;
411                                        if (q < 1) {
412                                                addToTooltipCargo = 1f; // add at least 1 unit or it won't do anything
413                                        }
414                                        tooltipCargo.addCommodity(com.getId(), addToTooltipCargo);
415                                        
416                                        float unitPrice = (int) getStockpilingUnitPrice(com.getCommodity(), true);
417                                        //node.upkeep += unitPrice * addAmount;
418                                        
419                                        FDNode comNode = report.getNode(node, com.getId());
420                                                
421                                        CommoditySpecAPI spec = com.getCommodity();
422                                        comNode.icon = spec.getIconName();
423                                        comNode.upkeep += unitPrice * drawAmount;
424                                        comNode.custom = com;
425                                        
426                                        if (comNode.custom2 == null) {
427                                                comNode.custom2 = 0f;
428                                        }
429                                        comNode.custom2 = (Float)comNode.custom2 + drawAmount;
430                                        
431                                        float qty = Math.max(1, (Float) comNode.custom2);
432                                        qty = (float) Math.ceil(qty);
433                                        comNode.name = spec.getName() + " " + Strings.X + Misc.getWithDGS(qty);
434                                        comNode.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
435                                }
436                        }
437                        return true;
438                }
439                return false;
440        }

450        public void reportEconomyTick(int iterIndex) {
451                if (isEconomyListenerExpired()) {
452                        Global.getSector().getListenerManager().removeListener(this);
453                        return;
454                }
455                
456                int lastIterInMonth = (int) Global.getSettings().getFloat("economyIterPerMonth") - 1;
457                if (iterIndex != lastIterInMonth) return;
458                
459                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
460                        CargoAPI copy = taken.createCopy();
461                        taken.removeAll(left);
462                        left.removeAll(copy);
463                        
464                        MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
465                        
466                        
467                        for (CargoStackAPI stack : taken.getStacksCopy()) {
468                                if (!stack.isCommodityStack()) continue;
469                                
470                                FDNode node = report.getRestockingNode(market);
471                                CargoAPI tooltipCargo = (CargoAPI) node.custom2;
472                                
473                                float addToTooltipCargo = stack.getSize();
474                                String cid = stack.getCommodityId();
475                                float q = tooltipCargo.getCommodityQuantity(cid) + addToTooltipCargo;
476                                if (q < 1) {
477                                        addToTooltipCargo = 1f; // add at least 1 unit or it won't do anything
478                                }
479                                tooltipCargo.addCommodity(cid, addToTooltipCargo);
480                                
481                                float unitPrice = (int) getStockpilingUnitPrice(stack.getResourceIfResource(), false);
482                                //node.upkeep += unitPrice * addAmount;
483                                
484                                FDNode comNode = report.getNode(node, cid);
485                                        
486                                CommoditySpecAPI spec = stack.getResourceIfResource();
487                                comNode.icon = spec.getIconName();
488                                comNode.upkeep += unitPrice * addToTooltipCargo;
489                                comNode.custom = market.getCommodityData(cid);
490                                
491                                if (comNode.custom2 == null) {
492                                        comNode.custom2 = 0f;
493                                }
494                                comNode.custom2 = (Float)comNode.custom2 + addToTooltipCargo;
495                                
496                                float qty = Math.max(1, (Float) comNode.custom2);
497                                qty = (float) Math.ceil(qty);
498                                comNode.name = spec.getName() + " " + Strings.X + Misc.getWithDGS(qty);
499                                comNode.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
500                        }
501                }
502                taken.clear();
503        }

519        public String getTariffValueOverride() {
520                if (preTransactionCargoCopy == null) return null; // could happen when visiting colony from colony list screen
521                CargoAPI cargo = getCargo();
522                //preTransactionCargoCopy;
523                
524                float total = 0f;
525                Set<String> seen = new HashSet<String>();
526                for (CargoStackAPI stack : preTransactionCargoCopy.getStacksCopy()) {
527                        if (!stack.isCommodityStack()) continue;
528                        
529                        String cid = stack.getCommodityId();
530                        if (seen.contains(cid)) continue;
531                        seen.add(cid);
532                        
533                        CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(cid);
534                        
535                        int pre = (int) preTransactionCargoCopy.getCommodityQuantity(cid);
536                        int post = (int) cargo.getCommodityQuantity(cid);
537                        
538                        int units = pre - post; // player taking this many units
539                        
540                        units -= left.getCommodityQuantity(cid);
541                        
542                        if (units > 0) {
543                                float price = getStockpilingUnitPrice(com.getCommodity(), false);
544                                total += price * units;
545                        }
546                }
547                
548                return Misc.getDGSCredits(total);
549        }

569        protected void createTooltipAfterDescription(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded) {
570                List<CommodityOnMarketAPI> all = new ArrayList<CommodityOnMarketAPI>(market.getAllCommodities());
571                
572                Collections.sort(all, new Comparator<CommodityOnMarketAPI>() {
573                        public int compare(CommodityOnMarketAPI o1, CommodityOnMarketAPI o2) {
574                                int limit1 = getStockpileLimit(o1);
575                                int limit2 = getStockpileLimit(o2);
576                                return limit2 - limit1;
577                        }
578                });
579
580                float opad = 10f;
581                
582                tooltip.beginGridFlipped(400f, 1, 70f, opad);
583                int j = 0;
584                for (CommodityOnMarketAPI com : all) {
585                        if (com.isNonEcon()) continue;
586                        if (com.getCommodity().isMeta()) continue;
587                        
588                        if (!shouldHaveCommodity(com)) continue;
589                        
590                        int limit = (int) Math.round(getStockpileLimit(com) * getStockpilingAddRateMult(com));
591                        if (limit <= 0) continue;
592                        
593                        tooltip.addToGrid(0, j++,
594                                        com.getCommodity().getName(),
595                                        Misc.getWithDGS(limit));
596                                                //Misc.getWithDGS(curr) + " / " + Misc.getWithDGS(limit));
597                }
598                
599                tooltip.addPara("A portion of the resources produced by the colony will be made available here. " +
600                                "These resources can be extracted from the colony's economy for a cost equal to %s of their base value. " +
601                                "This cost will be deducted at the end of the month.", opad,
602                                Misc.getHighlightColor(), "" + (int)Math.round(STOCKPILE_COST_MULT * 100f) + "%");
603                
604                tooltip.addPara("These resources can also be used to counter temporary shortages, for a " +
605                                "cost equal to %s of their base value. If additional resources are placed here, they " +
606                                "will be used as well, at no cost.", opad,
607                                Misc.getHighlightColor(), "" + (int)Math.round(STOCKPILE_SHORTAGE_COST_MULT * 100f) + "%");
608                
609                
610                tooltip.addSectionHeading("Stockpiled per month", market.getFaction().getBaseUIColor(), market.getFaction().getDarkUIColor(), Alignment.MID, opad);
611                if (j > 0) {
612                        tooltip.addGrid(opad);
613                        
614                        tooltip.addPara("Stockpiles are limited to %s the monthly rate.", opad,
615                                        Misc.getHighlightColor(), "" + (int)STOCKPILE_MAX_MONTHS + Strings.X);
616                } else {
617                        tooltip.addPara("No stockpiling.", opad);
618                }       
619        }
